action_input.code:
import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Get qualifying post IDs from SQLite
conn = sqlite3.connect('db/posts.db')
qualifying_posts = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE ViewCount >= 100 AND ViewCount <= 150", conn)
conn.close()

post_ids = set(qualifying_posts['Id'])
print(f"Number of qualifying posts: {len(post_ids)}")

# Load comments and filter by qualifying post IDs
comments = pd.read_csv('csv/comments.csv')
filtered_comments = comments[comments['PostId'].isin(post_ids)]
print(f"Number of comments for qualifying posts: {len(filtered_comments)}")

# Find comment with highest score
if len(filtered_comments) > 0:
    top_comment = filtered_comments.loc[filtered_comments['Score'].idxmax()]
    print(f"\nHighest scoring comment:")
    print(f"Id: {top_comment['Id']}")
    print(f"Score: {top_comment['Score']}")
else:
    print("No comments found for qualifying posts")
